title: FB-020 quarantine malformed file override entries
summary: Fix FR-010 by making queue file override manifest reads quarantine non-object entry values before queue/API consumers see them.
reason: Worker finding W03 showed version-correct file_overrides.json manifests could contain scalar per-entry values that passed read_file_overrides and later crashed serializers.
behavior_before: A file_overrides.json manifest with version 1 and an entries object could contain scalar entry values, and read_file_overrides returned those malformed values unchanged.
behavior_after: read_file_overrides keeps valid object entries but drops non-object entry values from the in-memory manifest returned to queue and API consumers.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_facade_queue_policy -q passed, 27 tests; tests.python.desktop.test_file_override_tracks -q passed, 32 tests.

validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage failed only for unrelated uncovered files: docs/implementation/dynamic-hdr-preservation/PLAN.md, docs/implementation/objective-quality-verification-plan.md, docs/reviews/function-module-audit-2026-06-11/workers/worker-08-webview-pages.md.
rollback_plan: Revert the file_overrides.py reader normalization and the corrupt-manifest regression test, then rerun the queue file override tests.
notes: read_file_overrides now drops non-object entries from the returned manifest while preserving valid object entries and the existing whole-manifest fallback behavior for invalid version/top-level shape. Strict change-control coverage for FB-020 is clean; repository-wide strict coverage still fails on unrelated uncovered dirty files: docs/implementation/dynamic-hdr-preservation/PLAN.md, docs/implementation/objective-quality-verification-plan.md, and docs/reviews/function-module-audit-2026-06-11/workers/worker-08-webview-pages.md.
